title: Naturality of residue homology for a localized perfect representative
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], E an object of its derived module category [def-pc-derived-category], a: O_S[0] → E, and s ∈ U. Let P be strictly perfect on the localized module site [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Write A for the complex with the restricted structure sheaf in degree zero and zero elsewhere. Fix e: E|_U ≅ Q(P), c: (O_S[0])|_U ≅ Q(A), and α: A → P with Q(α) = c⁻¹ ≫ a|_U ≫ e. Assume H⁰(Li_s* a) is invertible, where i_s is the residue morphism [def-pc-base-change, def-pc-derived-pullback]. Let F be the composite of the over-site equivalence to U, the module stalk functor at (s,hs) [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], and extension of scalars along O_{U,s} → κ(s). Then H⁰(F(α)) is an isomorphism of κ(s)-modules. No vanishing condition on the negative terms of P, and no linear frames, are assumed.

source.place: Tags 0E62 (residue-field arrow argument), 06YJ (K-flat derived pullback), 0D5S (composition), and 0098 (stalk pullback)

proof.text: The restricted structure sheaf concentrated in any integer degree i is strictly perfect: its support bounds are i and i, its term at i is the rank-one finite free module, and its other terms are zero. Specialize the generalized private helper at i = 0. Apply the simultaneous natural strictly-perfect residue homology comparison to this source and P.

The natural open restriction comparison conjugates localizedResidueHomology(R(a)) to the global residue homology arrow followed by global sections and residue-field scalar extension. These functors preserve isomorphisms, so ha makes that arrow invertible.

Apply localizedResidueHomology to hα. Functoriality expresses its image of Q(alpha) as the images of c.inv, R(a) and e.hom. Each factor is invertible. The termwise comparison square then makes H^0(F(alpha)) followed by its invertible target comparison invertible; cancellation of that isomorphism proves the conclusion.

theorem isIso_residue_stalk_homologyMap (S : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : S.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    [∀ x : S, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (S.residueField x)).toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory S)
    (a : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf) ⟶ E) (s : S)
    (U : S.Opens) (hs : s ∈ U)
    (P : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hP : Scheme.IsStrictlyPerfect S U P)
    (e : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
    (ha : IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (S.residueField s)).toRingedSpace)) 0).map
        ((derivedPullback (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).map a)))
    (c : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
        (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf)) ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U)) 0).obj
            ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
              (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) U).obj (SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf))))
    (α : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U)) 0).obj
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
            (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) U).obj (SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf)) ⟶ P)
    (hα : DerivedCategory.Q.map α = c.inv ≫
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.map a ≫
        e.hom)
 :
    letI : (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.Additive :=
      Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products _
    letI : (ModuleCat.extendScalars (IsLocalRing.residue
        (U.toScheme.presheaf.stalk ⟨s, hs⟩))).Additive :=
      (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj (IsLocalRing.residue
        (U.toScheme.presheaf.stalk ⟨s, hs⟩))).left_adjoint_additive
    letI : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor U.toScheme.toRingedSpace
        ⟨s, hs⟩).PreservesZeroMorphisms :=
      RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor_preservesZeroMorphisms U.toScheme.toRingedSpace ⟨s, hs⟩
    letI : ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor ⋙
        RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor U.toScheme.toRingedSpace ⟨s, hs⟩ ⋙
        ModuleCat.extendScalars (IsLocalRing.residue
          (U.toScheme.presheaf.stalk ⟨s, hs⟩))).PreservesZeroMorphisms :=
      { map_zero := by
          intro M N
          simp only [Functor.comp_map]
          rw [Functor.map_zero, Functor.map_zero, Functor.map_zero] }
    IsIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
      ((((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor ⋙
        RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor U.toScheme.toRingedSpace ⟨s, hs⟩ ⋙
        ModuleCat.extendScalars (IsLocalRing.residue
          (U.toScheme.presheaf.stalk ⟨s, hs⟩))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map α) 0)
